column1: # Gate thresholds for the native UI rebuild (docs/design/native-ui-rebuild/GOLDEN-STANDARD.md §9). Lead-only file.
# Measured by rb_gate.py evaluate on each shot's flutter/native PNGs, rasterisation-tolerant (lead calibration 2026-11-05):
# a pixel differs only when neither image explains it from the other's 3x3 neighbourhood (per channel, 24 levels slack).
# box_pct: differing pixels inside the shot's ink box (union of both inks, padded 4 px), in percent; it counts only when
#   more than 4 x blob_px pixels differ (one-line shots have tiny ink boxes).
# blob_px: the largest 8-connected cluster of differing pixels (a missing 8 dp dot is ~50 px, a recoloured icon ~80).
# ink_band: per text line (the ink box split at blank rows), native ink mass / Flutter's must lie in [1-band, 1/(1-band)]
#   (a w400 -> w500 line measures 1.13x; matching text 0.98-1.02x).
# shift_px: per line, how far the ink centroid moved (a block 2 dp off measures 2-3 px; matching shots stay <= 1.7).
# A shot passes when the frames have the same size and all four hold.
